items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: We're interviewing the Senegals here, and Mrs. Ozan.

ctx.x: Bunk Jones. Bunk Jones was the father of those guys. He comes to music. So many of them, I can't recall right now exactly that band. He played music with Bunk Jones. He was a fine player. A good mixer. He was very charming, too. He was a fellow who gave his heart out to everybody else and leave himself in the morning. He really did that. He used to give away all he made. Way around the last. On the last part, he found out he was getting old. He came to me. He said, you know, Calvary. I said, I don't know. I've…
